name: Overall Preference
insight: Highest Elo in the tracked set at 1508 on LMArena text overall. Mythos-class capability with conservative safety fallbacks to Opus 4.8 on flagged queries.

name: Coding & Engineering
insight: 95.0% on SWE-bench Verified and 80% on SWE-bench Pro — well ahead of Opus 4.8. Best pick for long-horizon agentic coding when the 2× price premium is justified.

name: Hard Reasoning & Science
insight: Leads on PhD-level benchmarks like GPQA and ARC-AGI subsets. Claude and Grok are strong contenders.

name: Honest Daily Use
insight: Shines for maximally truthful, witty conversation. Great for brainstorming without corporate polish.
